title: Define and Query Searchable Business Data
readerIntent: Add searchable behavior to an existing business schema through the supported source contracts.
priorKnowledge: Know the owning module, schema, permissions, and expected query use cases.
owner: Owning business module and Nodics search capability
summary: Declare index ownership beside the business capability, keep engine options in provider configuration, and verify query and indexing boundaries.

sections.heading: Before implementation
items: Identify the authoritative schema and stable record identity.
List searchable fields, filters, sorting, pagination, and aggregation needs.
Define tenant, enterprise, catalog, ownership, and permission boundaries.
Choose indexing triggers, refresh expectations, and outage behavior.

sections.heading: Implementation path
items: Add the index definition to the owning module under src/search/indexes.js.
Keep schema and index field definitions aligned.
Use provider-neutral search services and secured routes.
Configure engine endpoints, credentials, aliases, and provider options outside business source.
Regenerate affected search services, routes, tests, OpenAPI, and AI context.

sections.heading: Verification
items: Valid filters, sorting, pagination, and empty results.
Invalid query shape and unsupported properties.
Create, update, delete, and bulk index synchronization.
Provider outage, stale data, cache interaction, and recovery.
Normal schema save and update regression behavior.
